WHO IT’S FOR

Marketing leads, commercial directors and managing directors wanting to see which campaigns produce real quotes and orders.

STATUS & WHAT YOU CAN REVIEW

Compare campaigns by qualified leads, attended meetings, won deals, all-leads conversion rate and Unattributed records (with automatic duplicate prospect protection).
Problems we solve

Where work slows down

  • Marketing activity is judged on clicks or impressions rather than qualified leads, meetings and wins.
  • Unattributed enquiries distort campaign ROI when source records are not reconciled.
  • Teams lack a single view connecting campaign effort to real Sales progression.
What we offer

What your team receives

  • Content, campaigns and outcomes hub: documented pilot reports qualified leads, attended meetings and wins from imported Sales campaign data, keeping Unattributed leads visible.
  • Automatic rejection of duplicate prospect IDs during manual JSON import.
  • Content repurposing, AI avatars, approval workflows, scheduling and social monitoring are Planned.

CAPABILITIES & WORKFLOWS

What Marketing & Social Media
lets your team do.

Verified capability is browser-based Campaign Outcomes reporting from a manual Sales JSON export; ad spend, provider analytics and social publishing remain unverified.

01

Campaign progression funnel

Compares total imported leads, qualified leads, attended meetings and won deals side by side for each source campaign.

02

Explicit manual transfer boundary

Data enters via manual Sales JSON export and browser upload rather than unverified live ad-platform webhooks.

03

Unattributed row visibility

Prospects missing a campaign source remain visible in an explicit Unattributed row so commercial totals always reconcile.

04

Ad spend, analytics & publishing (Planned)

Automated ad spend pulls, external web analytics connectors and live social media scheduling/publishing remain unverified and Planned.

EXAMPLE TO SHOW & DEPLOYMENT SCOPE

In practice &
verified scope.

EXAMPLE TO SHOW

A marketer imports the Sales campaign outcomes export, compares qualified leads and wins by campaign and spots leads with no recorded attribution.

SECTOR WORKFLOW DETAIL

At month-end, marketing exports the Sales outcomes JSON from Sales & Intelligence and loads it in the Marketing browser view. The team compares two regional wholesale campaigns by won orders, spots 4 Unattributed deals needing source tagging, and sees an accidental duplicate prospect ID safely rejected.
